category: Branding and wording for each client

history.name: The client's logo, or a wordmark until there is one
history.description: The edition's front page carries the client's logo, embedded into the file so the finished document never depends on where that image lives. A project without one yet gets the product's name set as a serif wordmark — a real masthead rather than a placeholder — so a presentable edition exists before anyone has gone looking for the client's asset files.
history.dev_notes: mastheadHtml() embeds PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP as a data URI at the configured height; an unsupported type or a missing file is named outright.
